column3: MT 53:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1; “on Mahalath” is rendered “according to Mahalath.”
Close to the Hebrew; “turns back” is rendered “has turned aside.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Do they not know” is rendered “Have … no knowledge.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a fear that was not fear” is rendered “where no fear had been.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Who will give” is rendered “Oh, that,” and “turns back the captivity of His people” as “restores His captive people.”
